purpose: Single-root-lockfile invariant. The audit-contract suite must assert that the repo contains exactly one package-lock.json and that no .npmrc pins a peer-deps workaround. Wave verification (P3/P4/P5) re-runs this check.

npmrc_invariant.notes: No .npmrc is present. Adding one (especially with --legacy-peer-deps) is a workaround that must be justified in tech-debt.md.

workspaces_invariant.notes: No new workspace globs. Adding nested workspaces (e.g., apps/integrated-math-3/*) violates the flat workspace rule.
